notes.title: Patch Notes 1.3
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42825923/2543b2347e6804946d3b844f190031f50a18b559.png
Bug Fixes
- Some users getting stuck at the start, before tutorial - should be fixed now (thanks for reporting in the forums!)
- Jobs (bulletin board) where rewards sometimes not being granted, confirmation message also added
- Other minor fixes, letter patches may occur within the next couple of days for more minor tweaks on Windows builds

QoL / UI Updates
- Can now purchase multiple at the stall - will propagate this to other shops after a bit more testing

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.2a
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42825923/18e12409c8fa8c5f9fd81c40ff7367e30366d10e.png
BUG FIXES:
- tame bar decreasing sometimes incorrectly
- elemental combos trigger parameters
- minor visual error with recipes
- loading a saved team that had a merged pet
- some minor tweaks

Letter patches will update Win builds (demo + EA) and decimal patches will include all platforms (Win/Mac/Linux) for demo only. EA still has Mac/Linux unavailable due to lack of testing resources but hopefully demos on those platforms will help

I'm also creating video guides for mid/late game features that can be confusing! Let me know if there's something that needs clarification on the forums and I'll try to address them as well ^^

Same goes for bugs, please post them on the forum here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1929720/discussions/1/ so taht I can try to get them fixed asap. Thank you so much!

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42825923/bfafc191e785dee30553492855912b5dc882f47c.png
Pixel Petkeeper is out on Early Access! Current Version is V 1.2 for both EA and Demo.

Full gameplay with linear simple story line is implemented so you will get the entire game experience. Collect dozens of different kinds of pets that auto battle, unlock different areas, compete in the arena, and merge and use artifacts to create your ideal pet and party!

FULL RELEASE
What's planned post early access is an additional post-game dungeon amongst bug fixes and quality of life updates. I will also be closely monitoring forums for bugs and issues as well as feedback to help improve the game!

Thank you very much for your interest in Pixel Petkeeper ^^
